title: Land Explorer
shareTitle: Land Explorer — Build Islands, Lakes, Peninsulas, and Bays
description: Shape green clay and blue water into landforms, solve Mystery Maps, or explore a free tactile coast.
learningGoals: Spatially construct island, lake, peninsula, and bay land/water relationships
Recognize four landforms from spoken clues and picture cards
Explore cause and effect by shaping coasts
interactionModel: Pointer-based pour and scoop strokes on a forgiving top-down clay heightfield; cards and tools use large tactile targets.
feedbackModel: Automatic semantic recognition gives spoken landform definitions, shoreline glow, and tiny boat or creature rewards without scores, timers, or failure states.

modes.title: Mystery Maps
modes.skill: Recognize the same four landforms from spoken clues and authored picture cards.

modes.title: Free Explorer
modes.skill: Explore cause and effect by pouring connected coasts, scooping inlets, and launching a tiny boat.
